AdcScan.description: One ADC1 scan frame as the DMA stores it: five 16-bit conversion results in regular-sequence channel order (probably one conversion per channel per trigger).

fields.name: ch0
fields.description: Raw ADC1 result of scan slot 0 (12-bit value, 0..4095).

fields.description: Raw ADC1 result of scan slot 1 (12-bit value, 0..4095).

fields.name: ch2
fields.description: Raw ADC1 result of scan slot 2 (12-bit value, 0..4095).

fields.name: ch3
fields.description: Raw ADC1 result of scan slot 3 (12-bit value, 0..4095).

fields.name: ch4
fields.description: Raw ADC1 result of scan slot 4 (12-bit value, 0..4095).
